body.name: Numerical-delta and known-cell oracle endpoint intervals
body.construction: For endpoint coordinate \(r\in\{1,2\}\), let \(v_{r,n}^{\mathrm{ND}}=[\widehat J_{q,n}\widetilde\Omega_n\widehat J_{q,n}^\top]_{rr}\) and \(v_{r,n}^{\mathrm{or}}=[J_q(\bar h_n)\widetilde\Omega_nJ_q(\bar h_n)^\top]_{rr}\). The \(r\)-th members of \(\mathcal I_{q,n}^{\mathrm{ND}}\) and \(\mathcal I_{q,n}^{\mathrm{or}}\) are respectively \(\psi_{q,r}(\bar h_n)\pm\Phi^{-1}(1-\alpha/2)\sqrt{v_{r,n}^{\mathrm{ND}}/n}\) and \(\psi_{q,r}(\bar h_n)\pm\Phi^{-1}(1-\alpha/2)\sqrt{v_{r,n}^{\mathrm{or}}/n}\), where \(\Phi\) is the standard-normal distribution function.
